relTest.notes: Photo notes and the ✓ always go to the photo you just took, even when shooting fast. Photos save in the background; Finish inspection checks everything is saved and shows a summary. New Settings → Saving → Test SD card. One-hand note window with a big Hold to talk button. Category overviews from the area box. Drawing: the chosen tool stays selected, and you can drag a drawing to move it. Full-screen captions view: draw in the side panel, Remove from report. Pitch gauge on resized/report copies (raw kept clean). Site map button lists the project's site maps. Phone ready card on your account page.
